places-walwick-fell-roman-temporary-camp.story: From Hexham it runs 254 km to Hexham; allow about 4 h 23 of riding. It goes by way of Hadrian's Wall and vallum between Birky La, Rise How tower 25a and back through Hadrian's Wall and vallum between Birky La. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
